mapper.sql: id, payment_id, application_id, kind, version, doc_number, verify_code, media_id, sha256, byte_size, generated_at, delivered_at, create_by, create_time
mapper.insert: insert into nad_payment_document (payment_id, application_id, kind, version, doc_number, verify_code, media_id, sha256, byte_size, generated_at, delivered_at, create_by, create_time) values (#{paymentId}, #{applicationId}, #{kind}, #{version}, #{docNumber}, #{verifyCode}, #{mediaId}, #{sha256}, #{byteSize}, #{generatedAt}, #{deliveredAt}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select from nad_payment_document d where d.application_id = #{applicationId} and d.version = (select max(x.version) from nad_payment_document x where x.payment_id = d.payment_id and x.kind = d.kind) order by d.kind, d.id

select p.id, p.application_id, p.application_reference, p.applicant_id, p.applicant_name, p.kind, p.amount, p.currency, p.method, p.reference, p.status, p.expires_at, p.student_txn_no, p.proof_media_id, p.submitted_at, p.verified_by, p.verified_at, p.rejection_reason, p.version, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time from nad_application_payment p where p.status = 'CONFIRMED' and not exists (select 1 from nad_payment_document d where d.payment_id = p.id and d.kind = 'RECEIPT') order by p.id limit #{limit}

select p.id, p.application_id, p.application_reference, p.applicant_id, p.applicant_name, p.kind, p.amount, p.currency, p.method, p.reference, p.status, p.expires_at, p.student_txn_no, p.proof_media_id, p.submitted_at, p.verified_by, p.verified_at, p.rejection_reason, p.version, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time from nad_application_payment p where p.status = 'CONFIRMED' and exists (select 1 from nad_payment_document d where d.payment_id = p.id and d.kind = 'APPLICATION_FORM' and d.version = 1) and not exists (select 1 from nad_payment_document d where d.payment_id = p.id and d.kind = 'APPLICATION_FORM' and d.version = 2) order by p.id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update nad_payment_document set delivered_at = #{now} where id = #{documentId} and delivered_at is null
mapper.insert: insert into nad_payment_document_delivery (document_id, recipient_user_id, claimed_at) values (#{documentId}, #{userId}, #{now})
mapper.update: update nad_payment_document_delivery set sent_at = #{now} where document_id = #{documentId} and recipient_user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from nad_payment_document_delivery where document_id = #{documentId} and recipient_user_id = #{userId} and sent_at is null
mapper.select: select max(sent_at) from nad_payment_document_delivery where document_id = #{documentId}
mapper.update: update nad_payment_document set delivered_at = null where id = #{documentId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from nad_payment_document_delivery where document_id = #{documentId} and recipient_user_id = #{userId} and sent_at is not null

select distinct u.user_id, u.email, u.nick_name from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.user_type = '00' and u.email is not null and u.email != '' and r.role_key in #{key}
select d.media_id from nad_payment_document d join nad_application_payment p on p.id = d.payment_id where p.applicant_id = #{applicantId} and d.media_id is not null
mapper.delete: delete from nad_payment_document where payment_id in (select id from nad_application_payment where applicant_id = #{applicantId})
mapper.select: select d.media_id from nad_payment_document d join nad_application_payment p on p.id = d.payment_id where p.application_id = #{applicationId} and d.media_id is not null
mapper.delete: delete from nad_payment_document where payment_id in (select id from nad_application_payment where application_id = #{applicationId})
mapper.select: select media_id from nad_payment_document where payment_id = #{paymentId} and media_id is not null
select user_id, email, nick_name from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
